entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Frank Leo is a Canadian Catholic prelate who serves as Archbishop of Toronto since February 2023. He was Auxiliary Bishop of Montreal from September 2022 until his appointment to Toronto. Since 2007, he has been a member of the Priestly Fraternities of Saint Dominic.
